label: Plaint (skeleton for a civil suit)

review.note: This is a skeleton only: it sets out the headings a plaint needs and uses only the facts you give. An advocate must complete and settle it.

notes: This skeleton follows Order VII Rule 1 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 in outline. It does not check limitation, court fee or the court's jurisdiction. Settle those before filing.
A plaint must be signed and verified by the plaintiff, and accompanied by a list of documents.

slots.label: Name of the court
slots.example: Court of the Principal District Judge, Coimbatore

slots.label: The facts of the case. Write one fact per line, in date order
slots.example:
That the Plaintiff entered into an agreement dated 3 January 2024 with the Defendant.
That the Defendant has not delivered possession.

slots.label: Date the cause of action arose
What happened on that date
slots.example: the Defendant failed to hand over possession as agreed

slots.label: Why does this court have jurisdiction? (where the defendant lives or the cause arose, and the value)
slots.example: the property is situated, and the cause of action arose, within the local limits of this Court

slots.label: Value of the suit for court fee and jurisdiction
What the plaintiff asks the court for. Write one relief per line
slots.example:
Direct the Defendant to hand over possession of the suit property.
Award costs of the suit.

blocks.text: The Defendant is {{defendant_name}}, residing or carrying on business at {{defendant_address}}.
Cause of action. The cause of action arose on {{cause_of_action_date|date}}, when {{cause_of_action}}.
Jurisdiction. This Court has jurisdiction to try this suit because {{jurisdiction_facts}}.
Valuation. For the purposes of jurisdiction and court fee, the suit is valued at {{suit_value|inr}} ({{suit_value|words}}).
The Plaintiff therefore prays that this Court may be pleased to:
Grant such other relief as this Court deems fit in the circumstances of the case.

I, {{plaintiff_name}}, the Plaintiff, verify at {{place}} on {{signing_date|date}} that the contents of the above plaint are true to my knowledge and belief, and that I have not suppressed any material fact.
